about: The structure of bringing up a change: the events a person learns of and the ways they hold someone to blame. It holds no sentences; they come from the mined bank (data/english/parts/bring-it-up.json) through src/english/mined/scene-bank.ts. A change row marked story is a printed story a reader remembers: its subject is the outlet that printed it and its topic is read from the story record; no one is blamed for it.
